seoTitle: Which Big Bang Theory Character Are You? Big Bang Theory Test (12 Questions)
metaDescription: Take the Big Bang Theory test: 12 everyday questions reveal whether you're Sheldon, Leonard, Penny, Howard, Raj, Amy or Bernadette — with your full character breakdown.
intro: Are you the genius with a very specific seat, the neighbour who keeps everyone grounded, or the one who secretly loves a good rom-com? Answer 12 questions about how you really handle friends, dating and everyday life, and find out which Big Bang Theory character you are.

characters.name: Sheldon Cooper
characters.title: The Rule-Loving Genius
characters.summary: Brilliant, precise and completely sure you're right — because you usually are. You like routines, rules and your spot on the couch.
description: Like Sheldon, you know exactly how things should be done. He has a roommate agreement, a fixed spot on the couch and a very specific knock.
Your brain is your superpower. Sheldon is a theoretical physicist with a genius-level mind — and he'll happily remind you of it.
Social rules confuse you a little, but the people who get you, really get you. And every so often you surprise them with how much you care.
characters.flaw: You find it very hard to admit when you're wrong — or to compromise.
characters.signature: His spot on the couch, a train set and a triumphant "Bazinga!"
characters.clashReason: they'd correct you — and make you follow their schedule

characters.name: Leonard Hofstadter
characters.title: The Patient Peacemaker
characters.summary: Smart, kind and the one who keeps the group together. You're the reasonable person in a room full of big personalities.
description: Like Leonard, you're the glue. He's an experimental physicist who spends as much time managing his friends as doing science.
You're patient — sometimes too patient. Leonard has put up with Sheldon as a roommate for years.
You're a romantic at heart, and you'll keep trying for the thing you want, even when the odds aren't great.
characters.flaw: You want so badly to be liked that you let people walk over you.
characters.signature: Glasses, a hoodie and a long-suffering sigh.
characters.clashReason: they'd let people walk all over them

characters.name: Penny
characters.title: The Street-Smart Heart
characters.summary: Fun, confident and great with people. You might not know physics, but you know how life actually works.
description: Like Penny, your intelligence isn't in textbooks — it's in people. She moved from Nebraska to chase an acting dream and learned to read a room like nobody else.
You're confident and social, and you're the one who drags your friends out of their comfort zone.
You grew into yourself over time. Penny went from waitressing at The Cheesecake Factory to a successful career in pharmaceutical sales.
characters.flaw: You can put things off, and you don't always take things seriously enough.
characters.signature: A glass of wine, a big laugh and a raised eyebrow at the nerdy stuff.
characters.clashReason: they'd think your interests are nerdy

characters.name: Howard Wolowitz
characters.title: The Showman Engineer
characters.summary: Funny, cocky and genuinely talented. You started out trying too hard — and grew into someone people really admire.
description: Like Howard, you've got a big personality and bigger talents. He's an aerospace engineer, and he actually went to space.
You were a bit much at first. Cheesy lines, loud outfits and a lot of confidence you hadn't quite earned yet.
But you grew up. Howard became a devoted husband and dad, and the jokes got better too.
characters.flaw: You can be cocky, and you love to remind people of your big achievements.
characters.signature: A turtleneck, a belt buckle and a story about being an astronaut.
characters.clashReason: they think they're funnier than they are

characters.name: Raj Koothrappali
characters.title: The Hopeless Romantic
characters.summary: Sensitive, sweet and a total romantic. You love love — rom-coms, grand gestures, the whole thing.
description: Like Raj, you're a softie. He's an astrophysicist who loves stars, romance and a good sad movie.
You used to be shy — Raj famously couldn't talk to women at all without a drink in his hand — but you grew out of it.
You're emotionally open, loyal to your friends and always looking for 'the one'.
characters.flaw: You overthink every relationship and can be a bit needy.
characters.signature: A small dog, a rom-com marathon and a stylish cardigan.

characters.name: Amy Farrah Fowler
characters.title: The Awkward Brilliant One
characters.summary: Blunt, brilliant and more fun than people expect. You spent years on the outside — and now you're finally part of the group.
description: Like Amy, you're a scientist at heart. She's a neurobiologist, and she approaches life — and love — like an experiment.
You're blunt and slightly awkward, and you say things other people only think. But under that, you really want real friendships.
When Amy found her place in the group, she loved it hard — especially her 'bestie' Penny.
characters.flaw: You can come on too strong when you finally find your people.
characters.signature: A cardigan, a lab coat and a very enthusiastic hug.
characters.clashReason: they'd analyse you like an experiment

characters.name: Bernadette Rostenkowski
characters.title: The Sweet but Scary One
characters.summary: Small, sweet-voiced and not to be messed with. You're smart, ambitious and secretly the toughest person in the room.
description: Like Bernadette, you look nice. You are nice — right up until someone crosses you.
You're driven and successful. She's a microbiologist who ends up earning more than anyone else in the group.
You love your people, but you run a tight ship — ask Howard.
characters.flaw: Your temper appears out of nowhere, and it's terrifying.
characters.signature: A cute dress, a high voice and a look that makes everyone go quiet.
characters.clashReason: they'd be sweet to your face and terrifying behind it

questions.text: Someone sits in your usual seat. You...

options.text: Ask them to move. Politely. Then less politely
Let it go. It's not worth the argument
Make a joke about it and grab another seat
Give them a sweet smile that somehow terrifies them

questions.text: A friend bursts into tears in front of you. You...

options.text: Offer them a hot drink. That's what you're supposed to do
Listen, calm them down and help fix it
Hug them, then take them out for a drink
Cry with them

questions.text: You're on a first date. You...

options.text: Get so nervous you can barely speak
Treat it as a fascinating experiment
Relax. You've done this plenty of times
Try a cheesy line and hope for the best

questions.text: A weekend with no plans. You...

options.text: Rom-coms and a face mask
Nothing. Absolutely nothing. You've earned it
Practise an instrument hardly anyone plays
Build a gadget nobody asked for

questions.text: You're up for a big award at work. You...

options.text: Write your acceptance speech. Three versions
Tell absolutely everyone about it
Expect to win. You're the most successful person you know anyway
Hope you win, fully expect you won't

questions.text: Someone keeps breaking the rules in your shared home. You...

options.text: Call a formal house meeting. With an agenda
Sigh and fix it yourself, again
Promise to do better. Then forget
Deal with it. Firmly. Once

questions.text: You're asked to help with something you know nothing about. You...

options.text: Wing it with total confidence
Research it until you're an expert
Agree, then panic
Pretend you're already an expert
Go wherever everyone else wants. It's easier
Somewhere fancy you read about in a magazine
Book the place you wanted. Nobody argues
Suggest somewhere new, then study the menu like an exam

questions.text: You break something expensive at a friend's place. You...

options.text: Confess immediately, with a very detailed apology
Replace it before they even notice
Insist you can fix it. How hard can it be?
Hide it and hope for the best

questions.text: It's opening night for a huge new sci-fi movie. You...

options.text: Queue from dawn, in costume, with a strict seating plan
Go with your friends, then argue about it for weeks
Mostly there for the popcorn and the company
Let everyone else go. You'll be at home with a glass of wine

questions.text: You're offered a six-month research trip somewhere remote. Your partner can't come. You...

options.text: Go — and video-call every single night
Turn it down. Six months is way too long
Pack immediately. You'll be telling this story forever
Draft a detailed long-distance relationship agreement first

questions.text: A colleague publishes your idea as their own — and it's about to win a major prize. You...

options.text: Write a forty-page rebuttal and send it to every journal
Publish a better paper proving you had it first
Tell the whole department. Loudly
Complain to your friends, then quietly cry about it
